parent_pr.title: Consolidate codec recovery and bounded attachment coverage
parent_pr.body:
## Current hosted qualification

Observed 2026-11-20 16:42:28 UTC. Both workflows are associated with published head `6d4f6ea7ba9bcf886ae69edd0f167a621308d4b2` and are queued:

| Workflow | Actual run | Observed state |
|---|---|---|
| Alpha verification | [44775792417](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/actions/runs/44775792417) | Queued |
| CLI setup | [44775792011](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/actions/runs/44775792011) | Queued |

GitHub's current PR merge commit is `daee8e321009e04d0c82eee176ea5d2cec040181`, with parents main `449a619f1ae7b66cb42d9cab43dd5493bfe42c2e` and this published head. Its complete tree is also `ccd65c24112ae97c8ee7bf28a4bc5c9e560ede35`. The fetched published branch has an empty complete-tree diff from local documentation commit `02e478dd4d8b712e7a05ea7a1c66fd3be3faf6e4` and an empty non-documentation diff from execution source `d55bb48117c0f9e4579b01fd6c12030585601d68`. Actual job checkout and execution results remain to be inspected.

## Publication identity

Published head: `6d4f6ea7ba9bcf886ae69edd0f167a621308d4b2`  
Complete tree: `ccd65c24112ae97c8ee7bf28a4bc5c9e560ede35`  
Locally committed documentation/evidence snapshot: `02e478dd4d8b712e7a05ea7a1c66fd3be3faf6e4`

The complete remote tree exactly matches that local committed tree. Relative to reviewed/executed source `d55bb48117c0f9e4579b01fd6c12030585601d68`, all 101 later changed paths are documentation/evidence; runtime, tests, toolchain and workflows are unchanged. Main and all five contribution heads were freshly verified before publication.

## Why this consolidation is needed

Five independent recovery candidates share qualified main `449a619f1ae7b66cb42d9cab43dd5493bfe42c2e`. This PR combines their histories, implementation and acceptance while retaining the original handoffs and unsuccessful qualification evidence.

## Changes

- Preserve #64–#66: valid future-codec backup rejection, downgrade-export protection and foreign-tenant future-codec isolation.
- Preserve #67–#68: staged attachment recovery scope and a principal-bound, count-only `UnlockedVault.attachmentCoverage()` diagnostic.
- Select #68's exact tenant-index implementation. Accepted memory/IndexedDB reads visit at most the requested owner's holder limit; overflow returns unavailable counts. SQLite uses a tenant-prefixed limit-plus-one query. The cap remains 10,000 holder rows.
- Correct the last-holder test oracle to the existing deletion contract. Extend ordinary acceptance for rollback, failed persistence, retained transaction methods, queued lock, plain/encrypted reopen and record-only v1 restoration.
- Extend future-codec acceptance with compatible retry into the same rejected destination, complete stored-record comparison and stable identity after encrypted reopen.

The diagnostic always reports `holderAuthorityVerified: false` and `includedInV1Backup: false`. Portable attachment recovery and authenticated holder-parent authority remain future work. All 51 historical readiness findings remain open.

## Local validation

Reviewed/executed source: `d55bb48117c0f9e4579b01fd6c12030585601d68`, tree `7c2a8e3c341498f54e57489a31b2711c9034d3e5`. Publication adds documentation/evidence; runtime, tests, dependencies, workflows and configuration retain those reviewed and executed bytes.

| Check | Observed result |
|---|---|
| Full TypeScript | Passed |
| Four focused integration files | 20 passed, no failures or pending cases |
| Specification, dependency and strict registry checks | Passed |
| Eight full-domain shards | All 95 expected files; 839 assertions: **832 passed, 3 failed, 4 pending** |
| Isolated existing Mutiny budget case | Failed unchanged 60-second limit; 15 other cases intentionally filtered |
| Isolated complete vault file | 6 passed at unchanged limits; overlaps the full run |
| Tooling | 27 passed; no failures, cancellations, skips or todos |
| CLI | 46 passed; no failures, cancellations, skips or todos |
| Non-interactive setup and production build | Passed |

The three full-run failures were timeouts: existing Mutiny withdrawal-budget at 60 seconds, existing vault composition at 30 seconds, and strengthened future-codec acceptance at 30 seconds. The latter had passed its focused execution in 15.609 seconds. The vault file subsequently passed its separate six-case diagnostic. Both passing and unsuccessful observations remain; their cause is unresolved.

Shard 7 warned that tests were still running during JSON reporting. Four individual assertions remain pending although its aggregate counter says one. The verified recount uses individual entries. Two distinct existing parameterized cases share a display title; both remain in the 839 total. The original recount and an interrupted extra harness run are preserved alongside the corrected continuation. Overlapping selections are not added together.

Fresh final code, functional and defensive source review lanes found no new blocking production finding within their declared scope. Separate preservation and evidence reviews accompany the archive. These reviews do not establish a runtime or hosted pass.

## Source preservation

The publication commit retains main as first parent and all five current contribution heads as additional parents:

| PR | Preserved source head |
|---|---|
| #64 | `f598dc52937449764703b5048ba71a77239c9ded` |
| #65 | `5a742b5c4f1068f8bbd51d84de6a3de054df57e7` |
| #66 | `5bae3058bffec53c0fe04700c84232b8d7a5a84a` |
| #67 | `d1dcd44e839c7c28a33b94553f5cb3270ffc6d6c` |
| #68 | `7a3a962400e44a3d7bb2a6834c869f97bae88ee4` |

All original handoffs remain. Twenty of 22 contributed paths are byte-identical; only two integration tests are extended. The pre-publication inventory lists 74 branches and preserves all 57 original non-main references. No source branch was deleted or rewritten.

## Evidence and remaining gate

See the [consolidation cycle](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/tree/6d4f6ea7ba9bcf886ae69edd0f167a621308d4b2/docs/development/cycles/20261120-recovery-consolidation): `HANDOFF.md`, `QUALIFICATION.md`, implementation and independent reviews, preservation snapshots and `evidence/archive-receipt.json`. The archive retains successful, failed, cancelled and incomplete observations with source identities and byte digests.

Earlier main `449a619f` passed [Alpha 44713847841](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/actions/runs/44713847841) and [CLI 44713847763](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/CLASSifiedisRUPTed/actions/runs/44713847763). Its inspected Alpha log recorded 819 domain assertions, 27 tooling tests and 78 browser journeys passing. Those results belong to that main and do not qualify this candidate.

**Keep this PR in draft until actual current-head Alpha and CLI gates are resolved and inspected.** The local runs supply no new native-browser qualification. No deployment or release is part of this consolidation.
